answer: An agent network limits Sybil attacks using optical dispersion profiling. Each node authenticates by reflecting a laser off a mirror through a quartz prism onto sensors on a copper mount. An attacker forging identities must deploy discrete, precision-machined optomechanical benches per node, incurring steep hardware and calibration costs. However, ambient thermal expansion and acoustic vibrations can misalign the optical path, occasionally causing false rejections of valid agents.
